newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Compared to Thursday - Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Trade slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100 lb 2 ld 67.50.
